description: This Java class 'SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl' is an abstract implementation of an entity service for handling generic CRUD operations with entities adhering to 'SalesManagerEntity'. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing entities, along with utility methods such as flush, clear, and refresh, and supports querying entities by specific fields.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
classes.description: An abstract service implementation providing CRUD and utility operations for entities of type E, identified by key K, which implement 'SalesManagerEntity'. It encapsulates interaction with the data access object 'SalesManagerEntityDao' and utility functions for entity class handling.
